criteria.question: A-axis tile/layout/stage-fusion compiles and runs stably
criteria.evidence: wp2_summary.json gates radix2/radix4/fusion (grid=1); wp3 triton_multipass/triton_resident_loop correct on all cells

criteria.question: at least one explicit local storage space with capacity/visibility bounds
criteria.evidence: WP1 local_storage: explicit_space_selection_api FAIL; capacity_query PASS (262144 B reported) but placement is compiler-managed only

criteria.question: a verifiable overlap mechanism between stages or copy/compute
criteria.evidence: WP1 async_copy: async_mechanism_api FAIL; implicit_overlap UNKNOWN (no counters)

criteria.question: sync + packet ownership semantics sufficient for a multi-role resident pipeline
criteria.evidence: WP1 cross_program_concurrent_sync UNKNOWN; WP2/WP3 stale-read probes: store->permuted-load from the same buffer returns pre-store values at grid=8 (n=16) AND at grid=1 (n=32/64 sweep); debug_barrier ineffective; only cross-launch handoff (different buffers / launch order) is legal

criteria.question: at least one radix/local FFT P core embeds legally
criteria.evidence: WP2 radix2/radix4/scalar-codegen all correct; WP1 host_vendor_interop PASS; WP3 vendor path correct

criteria.question: fusion measurably reduces GM boundary/launch with stable independent-session gain
criteria.evidence: WP2 fusion: fused latency == split at N=16 (launch-dominated); WP3 multipass (log2(N) launches, grid=B) vs resident_loop (log2(N) launches, grid=1 packet loop) quantifies parallel-packet vs sequential-worker cost at larger N — single session, no independent-session confirmation yet

verdict.vendor_p_hybrid: GO (exploratory canary; selector promotion gated by holdout cells in wp3_holdout.json)
verdict.reason: criteria 2/3/4 fail (no controllable local storage, no async overlap, concurrent-sync/stale-read bug); converge per issue plan to restricted Triton A-axis (legal multipass/resident-loop batched paths) + host-level vendor-P hybrid; do not claim full hardware-efficiency validation

dtype_axis: fp32 only (fp16/bf16 vendor FFT not implemented)

vendor_fft_dim.finding: vendor torch.fft.fft transforms only the LAST dim: dim=0 silently computes axis=-1 -> callers must transpose non-trailing dims into last position

stale_sweep.pattern: store S0[p] <- x*2; load S0[p^1] (WP2 k_probe_store_gather)
stale_sweep.finding: in-kernel store->permuted-load is stale-read-unreliable even at grid=1 for n=32/64; small-n (16) and larger-n (128/256) were clean in this sweep but the tile kernel still corrupted at n=128 and crashed at n=256 (multi-roundtrip compounding / compiler limits) -> scratch ping-pong is not a legal general lowering; all WP3 Triton paths use cross-launch handoff only
